QuestInfo.name: Another Rumor
QuestInfo.1: Daisuke tells you a story about the Daimyo being possessed by the Gigatoad and bringing in ninja to guard the castle. When you say you need to enter the castle, Daisuke directs you to Sasuke.
QuestInfo.2: Daisuke tells you a story about the Daimyo being possessed by the Gigatoad and bringing in ninja to guard the castle. When you say you need to enter the castle, Daisuke directs you to Sasuke.

0.0: So bored. Wish I had someone to talk to. No one'll notice if I sneak in a nap, right?\r\n#L0##bHi! Hoshi said you're the man to talk to about entering the castle. You don't mind if I mosey on in, do you?#l\n#k
0.1: Oh! Hi! I don't much care WHAT you do, but are you sure you want to go in there? Haven't you heard that the Gigatoad has possessed the Daimyo?\r\n#L0##bEr, actually, this is the first I've heard of that.#l\n#k
0.2: GOODIE. Take a seat. A few weeks back, the Daimyo went on a fishing trip. When he came back, he was a changed man. He kicked everyone out of the castle and brought in ninja to be his guards. Only thing is... those 'ninja' don't seem to be human! And that's not all. When the chef brought the Daimyo his dinner one night, he said the Daimyo stuck out a long, stretchy tongue to slurp up the food. I haven't seen the chef since. \r\n#L0##bAnd because of all that, you're saying your Daimyo turned into a toad?#l\n#k
0.3: I'm not saying ANYTHING. But I AM strongly suggesting that, yes. With all those ninja crawling around, I haven't stepped into the castle in weeks, but if YOU want to go in there, talk to Sasuke. He's the one you have to convince.

yes.0: Fair warning: Sasuke can be a pain to deal with.

no.0: Smart. Get out of here while you can.

npc.0: Fair warning: Sasuke can be a pain to deal with.
